# Cncf Mirrord Reviewer

Review mirrord using its official documentation and repository in the App Definition and Development / Application Definition &amp; Image Build category. mirrord is an open-source developer tool that runs local code as if it were a pod in a remote Kubernetes cluster, with real env vars, DNS, network, and inbound traffic. Lets engineers iterate on a single service locally while interacting with the rest of the cluster, and is also used by AI coding agents (Claude, Cursor, Codex).

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
